modern: With regard to what happens in keeping with nature, we ought to blame neither the gods, for they do nothing wrong either willingly or unwillingly, nor men, for they do nothing wrong except unwillingly. So we should blame nobody.
original: With respect to that which happens conformably to nature, we ought to blame neither gods, for they do nothing wrong either voluntarily or involuntarily, nor men, for they do nothing wrong except involuntarily. Consequently we should blame nobody.
